verdict.rationale: A patent office running online register, search and e-filing services could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only web portals (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister), online filing tools (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAdirektPro) and paper filing. Nothing mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, or any public API, so the verdict is none rather than na.
